claims.statement: The frontend/src/lib/api/ subfolder holds the API client — index.ts is the barrel re-exporting api (the fetch wrapper from client.ts), ApiError + formatErrorMessage (Vietnamese Zod field translation) from errors.ts, and getAuthenticatedPhotoUrl from photo.ts; tests live in frontend/src/lib/api.test.ts.

frontend/src/lib/format.ts provides Vietnamese-locale formatters: formatNumber (vi-VN with . thousands separator), formatCompact (abbreviates >=1M to tr / >=1B to ty / >=1K to k), formatCurrency (12.500.000 ₫, integer, ₫ suffix, no decimals), a VND splitter returning { num, unit } for the <Money> component, and money-input parsing in frontend/src/lib/moneyInput.ts.

frontend/src/lib/date.ts provides Vietnamese-relative time helpers — formatDayMonth (DD/MM), formatRelativeTime (Vừa xong, X phút trước, X giờ trước, Hôm qua, X ngày trước) — plus month-name and week-start utilities.

frontend/src/lib/round.ts is a re-export shim of round2dp from @tingting/shared so pages can `import { round2dp } from '@/lib/round'` without importing from the shared package directly; the math lives in shared/src/calculations/round.ts.

frontend/src/lib/route.ts exports splitRoute(name) which splits "Hà Nội → Hải Phòng" into { from, to } using one of `→ ⇒ -> - – >` as the separator (used by the dispatch map, trip cards, and search dropdowns); tests live in routes.test.ts.

frontend/src/lib/maps.ts wraps the /api/maps endpoints with typed PlaceSuggestion / RouteSuggestion / RouteResult shapes and an in-memory autocomplete cache (50 entries, 5-min TTL); the Map4D integration lives on the backend in backend/src/services/map4d.ts and maps.service.ts.

cap-table.ts implements activePartners(history) which picks the latest snapshot date reached today and dedupes to the most-recent entry per partner (percentages auto-calculated from contributionAmount, never stored); csv.ts uses exceljs to produce brand-aware XLSX reports with title/subtitle/columnTypes/totalsColumns/totalsLabel (TỔNG CỘNG).

Other lib utilities include liveFleet.ts / liveRoute.ts (typed wrappers for live-fleet and live-route endpoints), notificationClient.ts (web-push subscription + payload decoder), audit-helpers.ts (audit-log color/severity formatting), calendar-month.ts (calendar grid builder with tests), profit-preview.ts (cap-table preview), expense-breakdown.ts (per-trip expense aggregation), status-variants.ts (TripStatus/PenaltyStatus to Tailwind variant tokens), overlayState.ts (animated overlay lifecycle), agentHighlight.ts (agent-directive UI helpers), tourTarget.ts (retained onboarding selectors), and utils.ts (generic sleep/groupBy/uniqBy helpers).
